name: Entity View Mode Field Plugin
description: Defines an EntityViewModeFieldPlugin plugin type and ships plugins that attach computed metadata (bundle, ID, UUID, URL alias) to content entities as display pseudo-fields.
project_description: Entity View Mode Field Plugin defines an annotation-based plugin type (EntityViewModeFieldPlugin) whose plugins each compute a scalar value from a content entity. hook_entity_extra_field_info() registers every applicable plugin as a display pseudo-field (extra field) on each content entity type and bundle, and hook_entity_load() attaches each computed value to loaded entities as a dynamic property named after the plugin ID. The five shipped plugins expose an entity's bundle, integer ID, UUID, and URL alias (separate node and taxonomy-term alias plugins). Despite its name the module does not expose the render view mode; the project is intended to pair with RESTful Web Services and the companion Entity View Mode Normalize module so these values can travel with serialized entity output.
